additional_concerns: Footnote 3 is present at da12aecad4e68.u30.3569: "Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission." Both permission claims incorrectly describe it as missing. Their core permission is supported, but their extracted conditions omit the e-Cert requirement; unconditional permission is unsupported.

XML submission also carries the schema and technical-test arrangements in da12aecad4e68.u14.2439. The separately provided XML schema is absent. The prescribed PDF form is also absent. These gaps limit format-compliance assessment, not the existence of the listed submission options.

The four declared missing dependencies have null source hashes and no descriptions binding them to particular authorities. Their identities cannot be inferred. Additional missing dependencies below are named descriptively rather than assigned to those opaque IDs.

The date-only candidate node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes filings before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. The general channel provision states "With effect from 2 February 2026", while the transition provision specifies a 9:00am launch and footnote 2 says "following its implementation". Preserve these competing temporal readings; the date-only interpretation does not establish the operational-launch interpretation.

The operational-launch candidates adopt an inclusive 9:00am threshold. The launch time is sourced, but the governing timezone is not expressly supplied in the packet. An externally resolved timezone requires its own authority; these candidates do not resolve the competing date-based reading.

Blackout urgent contact is not automatically an actual STR submission. Conversely, an email or fax contact that actually submits an STR should not be excluded merely because it is direct contact. Automatic migration is described separately from submission.

For the history candidate, a later STREAMS 2 resubmission does not erase the existence of a triggering historical event. This question does not determine whether the resulting duty remains outstanding.
The candidates use TRUE_IS_SATISFIED for questions whose true result means a duty is triggered. Consumers must preserve that typed meaning and must not interpret true as discharge or compliance.

Format, e-Cert and registration requirements are not stated as prerequisites to the footnote 2 trigger. Adding them to these trigger formulas would impose unsupported restrictions. Their absence from these formulas does not authorize submissions without those requirements.

Several event candidates classify non-filings as OUT_OF_SCOPE, whereas node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb can return false for a licensed firm's non-submission. Confirm the intended event domain before treating those outputs as equivalent.
